name: Encompass LOS
description: Connect to ICE Mortgage Technology Encompass for loan file sync, status updates, and fee-schedule retrieval.

name: Empower LOS
description: Integrate with Black Knight Empower for origination data, TRID disclosures, and closing documents.

name: Jira
description: Create and track mortgage operations tickets, link complaints to loan numbers, and escalate unresolved cases.

name: ServiceNow
description: Route high-priority mortgage operations cases to ServiceNow incidents and sync resolution status back to the agent.

name: Gmail
description: Send borrower resolution letters, receive inbound complaint emails, and archive correspondence.

name: Google Calendar
description: Schedule follow-up calls with borrowers and set RESPA response deadline reminders.

name: CFPB Complaint Portal
description: Pull inbound CFPB consumer complaints via the public API and auto-route to the resolution workflow.

name: MISMO Data Exchange
description: Exchange standardized loan data using MISMO XML schema for cross-system fee validation.

name: DocuSign
description: Send disclosure documents and resolution agreements for borrower e-signature.
